files.description: Elation's Designated Record Set for EHI Export — 7-page PDF data dictionary listing 199 data elements with their descriptions and export format indicators (Computable PDF, XML, JSON, CSV). Created from Google Sheets, dated 2/6/2024. This is the primary artifact documenting what data the EHI export contains.
Cleaned HTML extraction of the EHI Export Criteria article from the Salesforce Lightning SPA. Contains export instructions, Confidential Notes policy, designated record set description, and FAQs.
Full-page screenshot of the EHI Export Criteria article as rendered in Chrome.
Accessibility tree text snapshot of the rendered page, capturing all visible text content and page structure.
Rendered page 1 of the PDF data dictionary (200 DPI). Shows: Imaging Reports, Appointments, and Patient Demographics (Name through Notes).
Rendered page 2 of the PDF data dictionary (200 DPI). Shows: Demographics continued (Race through Current Prescriptions), including insurance and contact information.
Rendered page 3 of the PDF data dictionary (200 DPI). Shows: Medications, Care Team, Clinical Records (Problem List through Letters), Additional Demographics, Guarantor info, Orders, Social History.
Rendered page 4 of the PDF data dictionary (200 DPI). Shows: Eligibility/Insurance Verification (JSON format) and Billing - Bills (JSON format) including CPT codes, modifiers, DX codes.
Rendered page 5 of the PDF data dictionary (200 DPI). Shows: Billing - Bills continued (providers, service locations) with JSON format fields.
Rendered page 6 of the PDF data dictionary (200 DPI). Shows: Billing - Patient Liability with payment charges, payment processing details (JSON format).
Rendered page 7 of the PDF data dictionary (200 DPI). Shows: Billing - Payment Requests (JSON format) — final page, partially filled.

Bun TypeScript enrichment script that parses the PDF data dictionary into structured JSON using pdftotext -layout. Detects per-page column positions from header rows and classifies X markers into the correct export format columns.

Structured JSON extraction of all 199 data elements from the PDF data dictionary. Each element has: data_element, data_description, section, and export_formats (computable_pdf, xml, json, csv booleans).
Aggregate statistics from the data dictionary extraction: element counts by section and format, elements with no format specified, and parse metadata.
Documentation for the enrichment pipeline: run commands, input/output descriptions, parsing approach, and known limitations.
